formula.ascii: Indices i = floor(((featureMinimum - res)/(2 res))^(1/s)) and n = ceil(((featureMaximum - res)/(2 res))^(1/s)), mean-filter radii k^s pixels. d_k = z - mean of the (2 k^s + 1)^2 edge-replicated, nodata-skipping window (d = 0 for radius 0, so a first radius of 0 contributes nothing). MSRM = verticalExaggeration * (d_n - d_i) / (n - i), which equals the mean of consecutive filter differences (mean_i - mean_n)/(n - i). Invalid centres give NaN. In geographic or web-mercator mode each radius k^s becomes k^s * resolution ground metres, converted to a rectangle of at least one pixel per axis.
